dataset: Lower Mainland Crashes - filtered to NORTH VANCOUVER
coverage: North Vancouver (City AND District combined - see notes)
license: Open Data Licence for ICBC Information
notes: Retrieved through Tableau Public's built-in CSV export for a publicly published dashboard (the sanctioned download path; no access control is bypassed). Two material limitations: (1) ICBC's 'NORTH VANCOUVER' municipality value covers BOTH the City and the District, so records must be disambiguated by matching location strings to CNV street pairs; (2) records are location NAME strings with no coordinates, so geocoding to the CNV intersection layer is name-based and approximate. Crash counts are aggregate; no individual or personal data.
